NAME: Force Audio In - Test Tone
DESCRIPTION: Minimal stand-in producer (a fixed sine wave) that proves the ForceAudioIn injection tap works end to end. Toggling RUNNING here only starts/stops injectTone itself - it does not arm forceAudioIn.so or restart acvs, so it only reaches an Audio-In track if ForceAudioIn's own manage.sh ENABLE has already been run (it arms the tap once, persistently, at every boot). See README.md.
